rulesApplied: Canonical measurements use SI/marine-standard internal units.
Source measurements retain source value and unit in evidence assertions.
Unlabeled 'gal' is not converted to litres.
Year/configuration-varying specifications are not forced into one universal scalar.
Engine count is left unresolved when the model family was offered as both single and twin.
Technical classifications are normalized separately from marketing style/family labels.
Legacy fields may remain during transition but canonical fields take precedence.
Community contributions remain subject to evidence validation.
importantFindings: Albin 27 Family Cruiser production end remains disputed: owner-club history says approximately 1992; HMY/PowerBoat Guide says 1995.
Albin 28 TE Engine Box and Flush Deck are retained as separate B-Atlas configuration records sharing one hull family.
Albin 30 Family Cruiser legacy Sportfisher family classification was corrected toward Express Cruiser/family-cruiser usage.
Albin 32+2 and Albin 36 have meaningful single/twin engine variation, so model-level EngineCount is not forced.
Camano 28/31 tankage changed during production; handbook capacities are stored as era-scoped evidence rather than universal model scalars.
Nimble Nomad core dimensions are supported by owner/review evidence but remain moderate confidence because factory documentation is scarce.
Nimble Wanderer remains a motorsailer-capable model with power-only individual configurations.
